title: OUVIA: A User-centered Framework for Measuring Usability of Speech Translation in Real-World Communication Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing automatic speech translation quality, comprehension accuracy, and user-perceived usability across native English dialects and non-native accented speech (Hindi speakers).
Evaluating disparities in speech translation system performance and user satisfaction between self-identified US White and US Black speakers.
Analyzing differences in translation quality scores and self-reported usability metrics between self-identified male and female speakers across different language groups.
